result:
result: All earlier code findings are closed. The repair adds no regression to session start, status or the notice. It leaves four optional edge cases. Code review is accepted.

**Built-in `/code-review`:** I ran it with `high 323dfb1~1...323dfb1`. The loaded text was the built-in's, and it returned 5 findings. All 5 are real edge cases that I classed as optional, because the notice is advisory and cannot fail a command. Details are under the optional items below.

**Earlier findings, all closed:**
**Finding 1, wrong return branch (`status.ts` `startBranch`).** It now takes the oldest reflog move whose destination is an existing local branch, falling back to the source. After a clone and `checkout -b claude/x` it names `claude/x`.
**Finding 2, test gap.** `session()` in `cloud-checkout.test.ts` now commits on `main` before `checkout -b`. A new test asserts the reflog line `moving from main to claude/quiet-fox` and the notice `git switch claude/quiet-fox`, not `main`.
**Finding 3, detection logic.** There is no regression:
  - It stays silent for local sessions, linked worktrees and the start branch.
  - It still shows on a detached HEAD.
  - It now also shows when the checkout moved to another named branch, which has a test.
  - Every git failure still returns `undefined`.
  - `hook.ts` and `overview.ts` only had their description strings changed.
**Finding 4, `git switch -c` contradiction.** `claude-5.5/root/identity.md` and `kimi-k3.1/root/identity.md` now say `git worktree add -b <name> <path> <start>`. The `requirements/root/identity.md` line points to R-CLOUD-CHECKOUT, which exists in `coverage.ts` and `requirements/root/version-control.md`. The only `git switch -c` left is in the two `version-control.md` Branches lines, scoped "outside a cloud session (inside one, the next bullet)".
**Hostile branch names.** Both the reflog and `origin/HEAD` sources pass an allowlist and `git check-ref-format --branch`. The new test covers a hostile name from both sources.

**Optional, not blockers:**
1. **Clone already on the assigned branch (`status.ts` line 33).** If the clone starts on `claude/x` and the root then runs `git switch -c work`, the start resolves to `work` and no notice appears. I confirmed the reflog in a scratch repo. The repair report documents this limit. The observed platform flow (clone on `main`, then `checkout -b`) works.
2. **Ambiguous branch name (`status.ts` line 73).** `symbolic-ref --short` returns `heads/claude/x` when a tag of the same name exists. I confirmed this in a scratch repo. The comparison then fails and the notice shows wrongly. A fix is to strip the `refs/heads/` prefix from the plain `symbolic-ref HEAD` output.
3. **Rejected start branch (`status.ts` line 59).** If the start branch fails the allowlist and the checkout is already on `main`, the notice still says `git switch main`.
4. **`docs/hooks.md` line 28.** It says "four read-only git commands", but the notice now runs a variable number, up to two `show-ref` calls per reflog move. The loop stops at the first hit, so cost stays low.

**Tests:** `bun test packages/runtime/tests/cloud-checkout.test.ts packages/runtime/tests/sessioncontext.test.ts` exited 0 with 36 pass and 0 fail. I did not run the full gates; the repair report gives `mise run verify` exit 0.

Finding 3 raised no defect. The optional edge cases are in `status.ts` lines 33, 59 and 73 and `docs/hooks.md` line 28.
